answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 660 fakes pays 440 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The violet keeps the gate honest, the yarrow keeps the farm poor, and the fable keeps the honest agent paid.
